name: lab_billing_lookup
description: Read-only API exposing lab billing data absent from FHIR: CPT codes from the lab partner compendium, and the exact DiagnosticReport -> LabOrder link.

handlers.description: Serves GET /billing/compendium (orderable tests with CPT codes), GET /billing/report/<id> (the exact lab order behind a diagnostic report), and GET /billing/orders/<patient_id> (lab orders with LabOrder id, requisition number and test codes).
